submittedParameters.prompt: Edit reference1 into ONE independent transparent full-canvas NORTH run animation frame. Reference2 is established style only. EXACT same head, hair, camera, framing, upper torso scale, costume, hand poses, bow in anatomical LEFT hand at screen-left, empty RIGHT hand screen-right, right shoulder quiver. Change ONLY specified lower-leg/foot anatomy and tiny natural hip weight shift, never whole-image translation or scale. Her running direction is AWAY from viewer toward screen top. Ground contacts progress in depth along that direction, never sideways toe yaw. Straight foot alignment means knee/ankle/foot aim forward; preserve soft natural knees, not rigid locked joints. Keep entire costume, green/gold/ivory boot designs, fixed canvas margins. No background, drawn floor, shadows, labels or effects. The anatomical RIGHT foot (screen-right) is flat supporting weight in an EARLY UNDER-BODY position, still slightly AHEAD of pelvis in travel depth farther away from camera. Keep its green rear heel cup upright above a flat gold sole edge, no underside visible. Rearticulate its support knee/ankle with natural slight foreshortening so its projected gold sole contact edge is around normalized y0.894 (y916 on1024), rather than too far back at y940. It is a real load pose with knee flexion; do not shrink the shoe or move the entire character. The LEFT leg stays lifted behind with sole facing viewer. Upper-body pose and scale identical to target. This stage follows earlier farther-forward13/14 and precedes later closer-to-viewer01/02.
